## Checklist

- [ ] No real e-mail addresses, personal data or secrets in the code, tests or screenshots
- [ ] Database changes are additive (new migration; nothing dropped or renamed)
- [ ] Permissions are checked on the server, not only in the UI
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Screenshots attached for visible changes (desktop and phone)
